templates.title: Before and after
templates.summary: The problem up close, the quote at the counter, the work in two cuts, the result from the same angle.

steps.title: The problem
steps.position: At the counter or on site, phone above the problem
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the problem [the cracked screen, the stained sofa, the cluttered desk] and move in slowly until it fills the screen.

captions.script: This is what I walked in with, and it was bad.
Can they fix this? Let's find out.

steps.title: The quote
steps.position: Facing the pro at the counter
steps.direction: Back camera on the pro as they look at the problem, front camera on you. Say the price and the time they quoted.
steps.prompter: They told me the price and how long, let's see if they hit both.

captions.script: They told me the price and how long, let's see if they hit both.
Quoted price and time are on screen, now the clock starts.

steps.title: The work
steps.position: Over the bench or the work area, phone straight down
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the pro's hands and the tool on the work [the screwdriver lifting the screen, the brush on the stain]. Keep still.

captions.script: Here is the actual work, nothing hidden behind the counter.
Watch the hands, one careful step at a time.

steps.title: Up close
steps.position: Behind the pro's shoulder, with their okay
steps.direction: Stand behind the pro's shoulder and move in slowly toward the tool and the work [the new part going in, the last stroke of the clean].

captions.script: Almost done, and this is the part I could never do myself.
The last step, and you can see it coming together.

steps.title: The result
steps.position: Same spot and angle as the first shot
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the result from the same angle as the first shot [the new screen, the clean sofa]. Keep it still.

captions.script: And after, from the same angle as the first shot.
Same spot, same angle, and it is done.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: At the counter, with the result
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the result in your hand or behind you. Say if they hit the quote.
steps.prompter: Did they hit the time and the quote? Here is how it turned out.

captions.script: Did they hit the time and the quote? Here is how it turned out.
Would I go back? Yes, and I would book it on Loca.

templates.title: Meet the owner
templates.summary: Hands at work, the owner at the bench, who they are, the craft up close, their tip and the price list.

steps.title: Hands at work
steps.position: Beside the owner, phone above their hands
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the owner's hands and the tool on the work [a soldering tip, a camera dial, a pen on a worksheet]. Keep still.

captions.script: Meet the owner, and the hands behind the work here.
Ever wonder who actually does the work? This is them.

steps.title: At the bench
steps.position: A few steps from the owner's bench or desk
steps.direction: Start close on the owner's hands at eye level, then lean back slowly so the owner and the workplace appear.

captions.script: This is where the work happens, right at the bench.
The workplace, and here is how it is set up.

steps.title: Meet them
steps.position: Next to the owner
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, with the owner beside you, both in frame.
steps.prompter: Meet the owner, the person who will actually do your job.

captions.script: Meet the owner, the person who will actually do your job.
This is the owner, and I came with a lot of questions.

steps.title: The craft
steps.position: Behind the owner's shoulder at the bench
steps.direction: Stand behind the owner's shoulder and move in slowly toward the work in their hands [the part, the print, the lesson plan].

captions.script: This is the part that takes real skill, up close.
Up close, here is each step as it happens.

steps.title: Their tip
steps.position: Facing the owner
steps.direction: Back camera on the owner, front camera on you. Say the one tip they gave you.
steps.prompter: Here is their one tip for new customers, before you book.

captions.script: Here is their one tip for new customers, before you book.
Good to know: here is how they explain the price.

steps.title: How to book
steps.position: At the counter, by the price list or card
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the price list or booking card and point to the starting price.

captions.script: Starting price is on screen, book them through Loca.
Here is the price list, and the starting price is right here.

templates.title: First lesson
templates.summary: The empty lesson room, meet the teacher, your hands on the task, their correction and your first win.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: At the door of the lesson room, before the lesson
steps.direction: Start with the lens behind the door frame, then step past it slowly so the empty room appears [the piano, the desk, the easel].

captions.script: Sitting in on a first lesson, and I have never done this.
Back to being a student, at least for one lesson.

steps.title: Meet the teacher
steps.position: Seated next to the teacher
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the teacher beside you, both in frame.
steps.prompter: Sitting in on my first lesson, and here is my teacher for today.

captions.script: Sitting in on my first lesson, and here is my teacher for today.
Here is how my teacher starts a first lesson.

steps.title: My hands
steps.position: At the task, phone propped above
steps.direction: Prop or hold the phone straight above your own hands on the task [keys, a worksheet, a camera] while you try.

captions.script: My first try, and my hands have no idea what they are doing.
Trying it slowly, one step at a time.

steps.title: The correction
steps.position: Behind the teacher's shoulder
steps.direction: Ask the teacher to show the step again and film over their shoulder, moving in slowly to their hands on the task.

captions.script: Then the teacher showed me once, slowly.
One small correction, and here is what changed.

steps.title: First win
steps.position: At the task, phone held above your hands
steps.direction: Back camera on your hands as you get it right [the first melody, the solved problem, the first sharp shot], front camera on you.
steps.prompter: Here is how long it took to get my first one right.

captions.script: Here is how long it took to get my first one right.
Got it right, and here is the moment it worked.

steps.title: Book a lesson
steps.position: At the door or reception, by the lesson board
steps.direction: Phone low, start on the name or the lesson board and tilt down slowly to the price and times.

captions.script: Here is what a first lesson costs, and when they run.
Book a first lesson through Loca, times are on the board.

templates.title: Quick tip
templates.summary: One thing people get wrong, the wrong way and the right way with hands, and you trying it.

steps.title: The tip
steps.position: Facing the pro, the tool in their hands
steps.direction: Back camera on the pro holding the tool [a screen protector, a cleaning cloth, a camera], front camera on you. Move in slowly.
steps.prompter: One thing most people get wrong, and the pro here showed me.

captions.script: One thing most people get wrong, and the pro here showed me.
Stop doing this one thing, the pro here explained why.

steps.title: The wrong way
steps.position: Over the work, phone straight down
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the pro's hands doing it the usual way [wiping in circles, pressing the screen down]. Hold, then flick the phone right.

captions.script: This is how most people do it, and it is wrong.
Do not do this. The pro explains what it does.

steps.title: The right way
steps.position: Same spot, phone straight down
steps.direction: Start mid-flick, stop above the pro's hands and hold still as they do it the right way.

captions.script: And this is the right way, a little slower.
Do this instead, same tool, one small change.

steps.title: My try
steps.position: At the counter, the tool in your hand
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the tool in frame. Say how it went when you tried it.
steps.prompter: Tried it myself, and here is how it went once they showed me.

captions.script: Tried it myself, and here is how it went once they showed me.
Easy fix, and I had been doing it wrong.

steps.title: Where to go
steps.position: Outside, across from the sign
steps.direction: Phone low, start on the sign and tilt down slowly to the door.

captions.script: Find them here, and ask at the counter for more.
Find them on Loca, the service and the city are on screen.

templates.title: What it costs
templates.summary: The three most asked services with their prices, the work behind each, and how the pro quotes.

steps.title: The question
steps.position: Outside the door
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the door behind you. Ask the question.
steps.prompter: Everyone asks what this costs, so I asked for the three most common.

captions.script: Everyone asks what this costs, so I asked for the three most common.
Price check: the three jobs they do most, and what each costs.

steps.title: Service one
steps.position: Above the work for the first service
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the work of the first service [a screen swap, a one hour lesson, an oven clean]. Hold, then flick the phone right.

captions.script: Number one, the most common job, and its price.
The most asked job, and here is the price.

steps.title: Service two
steps.position: Above the work for the second service
steps.direction: Start mid-flick, stop above the work of the second service and hold still.

captions.script: Number two, a bit more work, and here is the price.
Second most asked, and here is the price.

steps.title: Service three
steps.position: Behind the pro's shoulder, with their okay
steps.direction: Stand behind the pro's shoulder and move in slowly toward the third job in their hands [the full repair, the package, the deep clean].

captions.script: Number three, the big job, and the price is on screen.
The big one, and here is what it costs.

steps.title: How they quote
steps.position: Facing the pro at the counter
steps.direction: Back camera on the pro at the counter, front camera on you. Say how they quote a job.
steps.prompter: Here is how the owner quotes a job before any work starts.

captions.script: Here is how the owner quotes a job before any work starts.
Here is how the quote works, so there are no surprises later.

steps.title: Book it
steps.position: Outside the door, after
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, the sign behind you. Say how to book.
steps.prompter: All three prices are on screen, and you can book it on Loca.

captions.script: All three prices are on screen, and you can book it on Loca.
Save this for the next time you need it, prices on screen.

problem.reads: The problem grows until it fills the frame; cut to the pro at the counter at eye level.

quote.reads: The pro in the back camera, held still while the creator speaks; cut to straight above the bench.

tool.reads: The pro's hands and the tool work in the frame from above; match-cut on the hands to over the shoulder.

detail.reads: The tool grows until it fills the frame over the shoulder; cut to the result from the first shot's angle.

result.reads: The result in the problem's framing, held still; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Face and result at arm's length, held still for the outro.

hands.reads: The tool on the work fills the frame; the next shot starts on the same hands and pulls back.

bench.reads: From the hands, the owner and the whole bench appear; cut to the selfie with the owner.

hello.reads: Two faces at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to over the owner's shoulder.

craft.reads: The work grows over the owner's shoulder; cut to the owner at eye level.

tip.reads: The owner in the back camera, still, while the creator speaks; cut to the price list from above.

prices.reads: A finger lands on the starting price from above; hold for the outro.

room.reads: The door frame slides off and the lesson room appears; cut to the selfie with the teacher.

teacher.reads: Two faces at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to straight above the task.

hands.reads: The creator's hands try from above; match-cut on the hands to over the teacher's shoulder.

correction.reads: The teacher's hands grow over the shoulder; cut to the creator's hands from above at an angle.

win.reads: The creator's hands get it right from above, held still; cut to the schedule at the door from below.

schedule.reads: The name slides up and the prices and times appear below; hold for the outro.

hook.reads: The pro and the tool grow in the back camera; cut to straight above the work.

wrong.reads: The hands work the wrong way from above, held, then the frame flicks right.

right.reads: The flick settles on the same hands doing it the right way; cut to the front camera.

try.reads: Face and tool at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the sign outside.

sign.reads: The sign slides up out of frame and the door appears; hold for the outro.

ask.reads: Face and door at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the first job from above.

one.reads: The first job in the frame from above, held, then the frame flicks right.

two.reads: The flick settles on the second job from above; cut to over the pro's shoulder.

three.reads: The work grows over the pro's shoulder; cut to the pro at eye level.

quote.reads: The pro at the counter in the back camera, held still; cut to the front camera at the door.

book.reads: Face and sign at arm's length, held still for the outro.
